name: Hana to Otome ni Shukufuku o
source:
The protagonist Tsukioka Akira is a normal guy living his usual life, except for one thing. His twin sister is sickly and is in the hospital and can’t go to school. Problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or worse drop out of school.

So their parents being the most clever people in the world, decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating. Of course it’s a stupid idea and he resisted, but him, being someone who is easily swept away, gave in.

So thereon starts his incredible life in an all girls school. 

[From [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's Review[/url]]
translation:
主人公月丘彰原本只是个过着普通生活的平凡男生，唯独有一件事与众不同：他的双胞胎妹妹体弱多病，正在住院，无法到学校上课。问题在于，她已经病休太久，可能不得不留级，甚至面临退学。

于是，他们那堪称天才的父母想出了一个办法：让与妹妹长得一模一样的彰代替她进入那所名门女子学校，冒充妹妹生活一段时间。这样等妹妹康复后，就能直接接替他的位置，无须退学或留级。这主意当然荒唐透顶，彰也曾极力反对；但他向来容易被人牵着走，最终还是妥协了。

就这样，他在女子学校里不可思议的生活拉开了序幕。

[摘自[url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany的评测[/url]]
